funding_notes: Reverie Labs (reverielabs.com), a Cambridge, MA (Boston-area) company founded in 2017 by Jonah Kallenbach (CEO) and Ankit Gupta (CTO) that used machine learning to design brain-penetrant kinase inhibitors for cancer; a Y Combinator alum. Closed a $25M Series A led by Ridgeback Capital Investments with First Round Capital, Y Combinator and Neo in Feb 2021, which the company said brought total capital raised to more than $32M. The amount_raised is that 'more than $32M' floor. Pre-Series A rounds (about $7M) aren't itemized publicly. In Feb 2024 Ginkgo Bioworks acquired Reverie's key assets (AI infrastructure, software and models), and four team members including CTO Ankit Gupta joined Ginkgo; terms not disclosed.

Verified domain capellaspace.com (SAR satellite operator, HQ San Francisco with Louisville, CO facility). SpaceNews (Apr 2022) reports $190M raised in total through the $97M Series C (NightDragon lead); plus $60M growth equity from USIT (Jan 2023) gives ~$250M total equity (sum of itemized rounds is $188M; the $190M figure includes other undisclosed/earlier financing). Acquired by IonQ (NYSE: IONQ); deal closed July 11, 2025 (SEC 8-K; purchase consideration ~$424.8M in IonQ stock per later filings). Acquisition value not counted as equity raised.
